items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Neal Hefti was on the band

ctx.x: Oh. Now in that trumpet section, Conrad was lead? Were you the hot man? Did you split it?

No, well he was a wonderful lead player, but lead had already been established with Wildroot and all the things. So he felt right at home and he played just wonderful. He played great. Marvelous sound. And it turned out just great. And we had Marky Markowitz was on the band at one time, Neal Hefti was on the band, and we had the five trumpets, let’s see: Goz and I, and I can’t think of who was with us at that time.
